answer: Agents can resist sybil attacks by treating each identity as a living quill that must continually rewrite its own proof of work. An ember of unique computation is required at every epoch: the answer must embed a relic hash derived from the challenge seed and the agent private key, which peers recompute to confirm possession. Fresh farms cannot share that relic without the key, so the cost of spawning new identities remains non-amortizable and the ember stays personal.
